technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions on RSI-9 with rising Williams %R suggest potential bounce, but price remains below all major moving averages with bearish MACD, negative CMF, and weak ADX—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: No actionable signals detected across insider, institutional, government, lobbying, or retail channels; earnings in 42 days presents material risk with minimal conviction support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional selling and absent news sentiment limit conviction; market capitulation signal dominates.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 317 crisis regime, rising DXY, post-FOMC volatility) creates severe headwinds; utilities defensive positioning offers limited refuge in this environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI-9 oversold (14/100 fear zone) with rising Williams %R and supertrend bullish signal creates contrarian bounce setup near support (65.76), typical of capitulation reversals.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish MACD, negative CMF, weak ADX trend confirmation, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis regime, and earnings risk in 42 days—macro headwinds and technical structure reject the oversold bounce narrative.
